response.name: Dhurandhar Collection
response.overview: In a high-stakes covert counter-terrorism operation, an undercover agent infiltrates Karachi's criminal syndicates and political power structures in Pakistan in an effort to dismantle a terror network targeting India.

parts.title: Dhurandhar
parts.overview: In the early 2000s, an undercover operative infiltrates Karachi's underworld, breaking into its inner circle to dismantle a violent nexus from within.

parts.title: Dhurandhar: The Revenge
parts.overview: As rival gangs, corrupt officials and a ruthless Major Iqbal close in, Hamza's mission for his country spirals into a bloody personal war where the line between patriot and monster disappears in the streets of Lyari.
